name: physicsnemo_mcp
description: PhysicsNeMo MCP server for PFR parameter inversion and surrogate training

tools.name: physicsnemo.list_registered_runs
tools.description: List all registered PFR runs with optional filters. Returns run metadata for building datasets.

status.description: Filter by run status (registered, validated, etc.)

notes_contains.description: Filter runs whose notes contain this substring

tools.name: physicsnemo.build_dataset
tools.description: Build a dataset from registered runs for training or inversion. Extracts specified targets and features from fields.h5 and kpis.json.

run_ids.description: List of run IDs to include in the dataset

aggregation.description: How to aggregate field data (default: mean)

tools.name: physicsnemo.train_inverse
tools.description: Train an inverse model to infer Flash physics parameters from observed data. Uses the analytical chi-DeltaB relation and fits specified parameters.

problem_id.description: Unique identifier for this inversion problem

run_ids.description: List of run IDs to use as training data

n_bootstrap.description: Number of bootstrap samples for uncertainty estimation (default: 100)

tools.name: physicsnemo.report
tools.description: Generate a report for a completed inversion problem. Returns fitted parameters, uncertainties, and fit quality metrics.

problem_id.description: The problem ID to report on

include_plots.description: Whether to generate fit quality plots (default: true)
